I will plant this beans plot the way I know will not trouble my pocket too much. On this small piece, I will use my own seed, put manure if I can gather enough, and leave chemical fertilizer because I do not want to spend cash there when the beans are mixed with other crops. I will spray for insects because beans can fail badly if I leave them, and I will use family work first, then call a few people for help when weeding is heavy. I do not irrigate this plot; I wait for the rains.
